exposure: Doppler USG positive for venous insufficiency
cohort: 35 pregnant women who presented to a hospital between January 2016 and January 2021 with leg pain and edema.
finding: No significant association was found between the presence of symptoms, Doppler USG findings of venous insufficiency, gravidity, or previous mode of delivery.
mod_finding: No significant association was found between venous insufficiency and previous mode of delivery.
gest_age: Mean gestational age at presentation was 28.71±7.92 weeks (range 12-38 weeks).
